text_block_list.text:
Time flies after Biwa Hayahide's<n>debut, and before
we know it, the<n>Asahi Hai F.S. has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My uniform is impeccable, and I just<n>checked my
cleats earlier...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I can't help that I am.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is a G1 race. It's my first time<n>running in such
a large competition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want to make sure everything is<n>perfect to make
the most of this<n>opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'd best get out there.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Aaand next up in the paddock is Biwa<n>Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even the crowd is louder at a G1, and<n>I'm pretty
sure I spot a few live<n>broadcast cameras set up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A lot of eyes will be on this race. Iwonder if she's watching too...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter. Either way, I don't<n>intend to lose.
